issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

preferredLocale.description:
Preferred locale.

- This {@link Locale} should be present in the application's seed data.
- If the user's preference does not match any of the available locales
  specified in {@link UiSdlI18nConfig#locales}, the application will use the first
  locale in the available locales list.
- If this available locales list is empty, the application will fallback to `'en'`.
